liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Althea** (1 review): Althea, China Cat Sunflower, and C.C. Rider are highlighted as rippers [27]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (1 review): One of the best Saint of Circumstances, with Bob ripping it up at the end [29]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd86-12-30 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t02 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t03 Althea**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t04 CC Rider**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t05 Cumberland Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t06 My Brother Esau**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t07 When Push Comes to Shove**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]
- **gd86-12-30 t08 Beat It On Down The Line**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [33]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-12-30.142302.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 174 min [1]
- **gd86-12-30.sbd.barbella.6025.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 162 min; rated 4.29/5 by 35 [2]. Said about its sound: Very good sound quality, featuring Bobby's guitar in Althea and vocal tweaks in Esau; Remarkable quality, with a notable alto sax performance on Iko Iko; Sound quality is described as superb for the entire show [22][23][31]
- **gd1986-12-30.176484.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 26 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd1986-12-30.137978.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 24 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [8]

## Around the show

- Kaiser Convention Center noted as a great venue for the Grateful Dead [24]
- Attendees sat third row center, enjoying a long first set and even longer second set [28]
- Hamza El Din played hand drum and vocals; Jose Lorenzo played shakers and hand bells [1]
- Hamza El Din performed on hand drum and vocals during Ollin Arageed [3]
- The Neville Brothers joined for Iko Iko, Man Smart, and Johnny B. Goode [8]
- Considered one of the best shows of the 1980s, despite the user's forgotten memory [23]
- Listener claims never hearing the band better than at this specific show [24]
- Theory that December 30th shows often outdid New Year's performances musically in 1986 [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-12-30.142302.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]. Also: FOB Schoeps CMC3/MK41 source supplies patches in Saint Of Circumstance, Ship of Fools, and Estimated Prophet [1]
- **gd86-12-30.sbd.barbella.6025.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Cm> DAT> CD> EAC> CDWAV editing > SHN (seekable) [2]
- **gd1986-12-30.176484.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [3]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies patches in Drums and Throwing Stones [3]
- **gd1986-12-30.137978.sbd.miller.flac24**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [8]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to make the show complete [8]
